**Agent Name:** Planner  
**Step Number:** 11  
**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner incorrectly interpreted the question as comparing the ages of the directors at the time of their respective film releases, instead of comparing their birth years, as explicitly stated in the task. As a result, the Planner determined Jos Luis Garci (born in 1944) to be older than Eduardo Morera (born in 1906) based on their relative ages at the time of each film’s release, which contradicts the task requirements. This misinterpretation led to the wrong conclusion that *Solos en la madrugada* has the director born earlier, instead of *Idols Of The Radio*.
